§6HeatProof Brick§f (internally called Blastbrick) is a fire-resistant building block for high-temperature machines. You need it for the Electric Arc Furnace, Precision Assembler, and blast furnace setups.

Craft it shaped: 1 HBM Polymer Plate on top of 1 Brick Block. That makes it the cheapest fire-resistant block in the modpack, so use it liberally for any machine that runs hot.

§cWARNING:§f This is NOT vanilla Nether Brick. The two are separate items. Polymer Plates come from HBM's petroleum processing chain, so you'll need to progress through oil refining first.

§ePS:§f You can pair HeatProof Brick with Carbon Bricks for carbon processing recipes in the Arc Furnace.
